trainer/31282.htm.text: Magister Justin: To tell you the truth, this temple's atmosphere is so solemn that it makes me feel want to take a nap. Thank goodness I can still concentrate on my studies... Are you here to study also?

trainer/31282-noteach.htm.text: Magister Justin: Not everyone is suited to the path of magic. Follow the path that is destined for you. Look for a master who will teach you to follow your own path.

Q00069_SagaOfTheTrickster/2-01.htm.text: Magister Justin: As a magician and a scholar, my insterest in life energy is extremely keen. While studying the Kamael, I have come to learn about the Tablet of Vision and the existence of the teaching stone. However, journeying to those dangerous places myself in search of the stone is too arduous…

Q00069_SagaOfTheTrickster/2-02.htm.text: Magister Justin: Seek out Warehouse Freightman Stefano and get my cells!

Q00069_SagaOfTheTrickster/2-03.htm.text: Magister Justin: Use ice crystals to deep freeze the tissues cells so they can be transported without damage. I am thrilled to finally obtain the research materials I need! Thank you! From what I have learned so far, the knowledge that can be gained from the Tablet of Vision is very abstract. It ma…

Q00069_SagaOfTheTrickster/2-04.htm.text: Magister Justin: Did you communicate with the Tablet of Vision located south of the Tower of Insolence ?

Q00088_SagaOfTheArchmage/2-01.htm.text: Magister Justin: Grand Magister Valleria didn't know that I'm conducting an investigation under the guise of Justin. In a letter I intercepted Valleria wanted Justin to discourage you from becoming an Archmage! Don't worry, since I'm not bound to him I can still tell you what you need to do to beco…

Q00088_SagaOfTheArchmage/2-02.htm.text: Magister Justin: Visit Information Broker Mist at the hot springs resort and pick up the Investigative Report I requested. Tell him the truth seeker sent you. Bring the report and I'll tell you how to get the power of the six stone tablets.

Q00088_SagaOfTheArchmage/2-03.htm.text: Magister Justin: Thanks for the report. This merits further investigation. To become an Archmage, you'll need a Stone of Commune for each of the six stone tablets. Use the stones to commune with the tablets and your path will become clear. Here's the first Stone of Commune, take it to the Tablet of…

Q00088_SagaOfTheArchmage/2-04.htm.text: Magister Justin: Commune with the Tablet of Vision south of the Tower of Insolence with the Stone of Commune I gave you. The path will then become clear.

Q00088_SagaOfTheArchmage/3-01.htm.text: Magister Justin: You say you fought with Allector, the fallen angel? How could he have escaped the prison in the Ivory Tower? He must have had help. But who? It could only be .... I shouldn't say, I need more proof. I have the Stone of Commune, but it's unstable. You'll need the other fragment .

Q00088_SagaOfTheArchmage/3-05.htm.text: Magister Justin: The Divine Stone of Wisdom! Good work. My hunch was right. The only person who could have freed Allector is indeed the Grand Magister of the Ivory Tower! Never let your guard down, there are powerful forces trying to stop you! Shall I combine the stones now?

Q00088_SagaOfTheArchmage/3-06.htm.text: Magister Justin: Take the Stone of Commune I gave you and go to the next Tablet of Vision on the north side of the Varka Silenos barracks.

Q00088_SagaOfTheArchmage/11-01.htm.text: Magister Justin: Now I must continue my investigation about who is trying to stop you from becoming a Mystic Muse. I'll need this stone myself, but I can tell you how to get your own.

Q00088_SagaOfTheArchmage/11-02.htm.text: Magister Justin: You can get the next stone by killing the Archon of Halisha in the Four Sepulchers. You'll need help to gain entry. If that proves too difficult, go to the Shrine of the Loyal and slay Halisha's minions. If you collect 700 Halisha's Marks , the Archon will appear. The minions inclu…

Q00069_SagaOfTheTrickster/2-05.htm.text: Magister Justin: Very well -- if you procure for me the cell tissues I need for my experiments, I will give you the Resonance Amulet. Seek out Warehouse Freightman Stefano.

Q00069_SagaOfTheTrickster/2-06.htm.text: Magister Justin: The Tablets of Vision are scatterd throughout the world. Each requires a different Resonance Amulet in order to communicate with it. This means that the Amulets and Tablets are uniquely paired. The Amulet I have given you matches the first Tablet of Vision, which is located to the …

Q00088_SagaOfTheArchmage/11-03.htm.text: Magister Justin: You can get the next stone by killing the Archon of Halisha in the Four Sepulchers. You'll need help to gain entry. If that proves too difficult, go to the Shrine of the Loyal and slay Halisha's minions. If you collect 700 Halisha's Marks , the Archon will appear. The minions inclu…

Q00088_SagaOfTheArchmage/2-05.htm.text: Magister Justin: I'll tell you in due time. Meet with Information Broker Mist at the hot springs resort. Get the Investigative Report I asked for. Tell him the silver light wanderer sent you. Bring back the report and I'll tell you of the six stone tablets.

Q00088_SagaOfTheArchmage/2-06.htm.text: Magister Justin: Stones of commune and Tablets of Vision have a magical mutual attraction. You can use this force to locate the Tablets of Vision . Put simply, when you have a Stone of Commune, the location of the corresponding Tablet of Vision will appear in your mind. After you commune with it, t…

Q00088_SagaOfTheArchmage/3-02.htm.text: Magister Justin: Then visit the Ketra Orcs to get the missing fragment, the Divine Stone of Wisdom . If you earn the trust of Asefa, guide of dead souls, through Ketra's Messenger Wahkan and prove to her your wisdom, you'll find it. If you change your mind halfway, you can get it from the best Sham…

Q00088_SagaOfTheArchmage/3-03.htm.text: Magister Justin: Then visit the Varka Silenos to get the missing fragment, the Divine Stone of Wisdom . If you earn the Soul Guide Udan Mardui through Varka's Messenger Naran Ashanuk and prove to her your wisdom, you'll find it. If you change your mind halfway, you can get it from the best Shaman o…

They know of its powerful magic, but not its exact use. They'll reward the wisest of their tribe with it. You'll need to earn the trust of Asefa, chief shaman of the Ke…

Q00088_SagaOfTheArchmage/3-08.htm.text: Magister Justin: Now it's a complete Stone of Commune. Go find the Tablet of Vision on the north of the Varka Silenos Barracks.

links.text: Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
